item.title: The Forgotten Engineers of the Ancient World
item.description: Explore the hidden legacy of ancient engineers who built the world's most amazing structures without modern tools. From the pyramids of Egypt to the aqueducts of Rome, discover how these forgotten visionaries shaped the world we know today.

item.title: The Lost Scripts of the Ancients
item.description: Explore the mysteries of ancient scripts like Linear A, Indus script, and Rongorongo as they reveal hidden histories and cultural insights. Discover how modern technology is helping decode these forgotten languages and what they tell us about the past.

item.title: The Hunt for Forgotten Knowledge
item.description: Explore the mystery of ancient libraries that were lost to time and the ongoing search for forgotten knowledge. From the Library of Alexandria to hidden scrolls in Pompeii and beyond, uncover the stories behind these legendary repositories of wisdom.

item.title: Secret Routes That Built Empires
item.description: This episode explores how secret trade routes shaped ancient civilizations, uncovering the hidden networks that connected distant cultures and influenced the rise and fall of empires. Discover how these secret pathways spread ideas, technologies, and even diseases across the ancient world.

item.description: Explore the hidden power of ancient maps and their role in shaping exploration and empire. From mysterious artifacts to lost knowledge, uncover how these maps influenced history and continue to inspire curiosity.

item.title: The Lost Legion
item.description: Explore the mysterious disappearance of Legio XIV Gemina Martia Victrix, one of the Roman Empire's most legendary legions. Delve into the theories surrounding its fate, from battle to absorption into other units, and uncover the historical intrigue that has captivated historians for centuries.

item.title: Secrets in Stone
item.description: Explore the hidden messages in ancient Roman mosaics and uncover the secret symbols that once communicated power, identity, and even warnings. This episode delves into the world of Roman public art, revealing how these intricate designs were more than just decoration—they were a form of storytelling that shaped the culture of the Empire.
